title: IBM OM crossbar STAR-inspired local-state-only post-fault recovery smoke
hypothesis: After class-conditional hidden-ReLU and output-logit means are captured from a healthy programmed source array and the matched published companion's sampled corrupt-device states are applied to that same plant, STAR-inspired local-state-only pulse-SGD will produce a positive mean apparent-forward recovery gain, with positive gains on at least three of four programming endpoints, while the post-fault update uses no teacher errors, cross-entropy backpropagation, transpose MVM, autograd, Adam state, or learner-visible fault locations.
motivation: The completed transfer smoke shows that continuous HWA is stable across repaired IBM-OM arrays but fails when published stuck/corrupt cells and their changing locations are retained. This exploratory successor tests whether STAR's neuron-scale class-state memory idea can repair the damaged same-array computation through healthy cells when adapted to direct local feedforward updates. Unlike the paper's task-nudged three-phase equilibrium-propagation rule, this arm freezes a local-state-only healthy-capture, AIHWKit-compatible post-deployment corrupt-device transition, and recovery lifecycle; label y only selects stored target row y. The corrupt cells have sampled collapsed persistent bounds and zero pulse increments, while their apparent state retains configured write-noise resampling. The smoke is an algorithmic model-based ablation and is not evidence that STAR works until the declared run, provenance, locality, and artifact gates pass.

arms.description: Program a counterfactually repaired continuous-HWA source, capture apparent-q hidden/output class means, replay the pre-sampled same-assignment published companion's AIHWKit corrupt-device states only after capture, and run one fixed STAR-inspired local-state-only stochastic pulse-SGD recovery epoch on the same plant.

completion_criteria: The one declared config completes exactly once and records the pinned teacher as source initialization, predeployment continuous-HWA teacher-KL adaptation, and evaluation provenance, while proving it is excluded from post-fault recovery; it also records source assignment 87004, endpoint seeds 89402-89405, AIHWKit 1.1.0, the 784-50-10 analog-MVM--digital-ReLU--analog-MVM architecture, exactly 1024 deterministic training-calibration examples, an ordered and hash-bound 16-example repair stream drawn from the same deterministic subset used by predeployment continuous HWA but disjoint from the calibration cohort, local state-error norms on the first 32 fixed validation examples, and accuracy on the first 1000 official MNIST test examples.

Every endpoint records one cross-validated ordered provenance sequence on the same plant: healthy programmed P0 state, pre-fault STAR target artifact, immediate post-fault state, and fixed-final recovered state. The run is invalid if the population, assignment, endpoint, deployed-q, off-chip checkpoint, apparent state, or persistent state changes outside the declared programming, fault-transition, apparent-noise resampling, and recovery events.

Each versioned STAR target artifact records and validates its artifact and receipt hashes, a healthy hardware-instance binding derived from population fingerprint plus assignment and endpoint seeds, pre-fault apparent and persistent hashes, off-chip model-checkpoint and healthy-deployment artifact hashes, state representation, hidden/output gains, ordered calibration-cohort hash, all ten nonzero class counts, FP16 quantization, and class-mean tensors of shapes [10,50] and [10,10] totaling exactly 1200 tensor bytes excluding metadata.

The healthy source uses corruption_policy=counterfactual_repaired. A separately recorded same-assignment published companion explicitly enables the OM published corruption probability 0.1348 even though the upstream preset default is zero, while retaining corrupt_devices_range=0.01. Its published mask must equal the repaired population's retained published mask, all non-defect sampled identity tensors must match exactly, and every corrupt cell must have its AIHWKit-sampled active min equal active max inside the intersected device bounds and [-0.01,+0.01], with zero upward/downward increments. The transition leaves non-fault cells bit-exact, fixes selected persistent q=a-r at the sampled collapsed value, and retains apparent write-noise resampling at transition and on later write attempts.

The recovery implementation and run receipt identify local gradients g_q1=alpha_1*x^T*[rho_h*(h-mu_y^h)*1[u>0]] and g_q2=alpha_2*h^T*[rho_o*(z-mu_y^o)]. For cell j in layer l, each physical command is ternary d_lj=-sign(g_qlj) with Bernoulli selection probability p_lj=min(1,eta_l*abs(g_qlj)/dw_nominal), otherwise d_lj=0; the receipt records eta_1=eta_2=6e-5, the sampled population's scalar dw_nominal, probability clipping, and the 64-command per-cell cap. This probability normalization leaves the sampled cell-specific soft-bounds pulse response in force. The post-fault update kernel receives only a restricted apparent-state/pulse port and no teacher logits, cross-entropy or softmax error, W2-transpose signal, autograd/BPTT gradient, Adam moments, FP32 shadow weights, or fault mask; label y is used only for target-row lookup.

For every endpoint, the run reports apparent-forward and persistent-q diagnostic accuracy at healthy P0, immediately after the fault, and at fixed final recovery; prediction hashes; local hidden/output state-error norms on the fixed 32-example validation cohort; total and per-layer commanded pulse counts; pulse caps; attempted commands to immutable cells and actual healthy persistent-q movement as post-hoc analysis; and source-inspection evidence that fault locations did not enter the learner update code.

The smoke performs no fresh-array transfer and no checkpoint selection. It remains planned or ready-for-review rather than scientific evidence until exact coverage is artifact-verified and reviewed; no experimental-manifest entry or claim of physical on-chip learning is permitted from the plan alone.
analysis_plan: Apply the validity gate first: require exact one-run coverage, the complete cross-validated chronological provenance sequence, target-artifact binding, companion-population parity, persistent-fault replay with apparent write-noise semantics, and locality receipt. If any gate fails, classify the smoke invalid and do not inspect accuracy as evidence for the STAR-inspired ablation.

For each endpoint report healthy apparent accuracy, immediate post-fault apparent accuracy, fixed-final apparent accuracy, healthy-to-fault damage in percentage points, fault-to-final recovery gain, and recovery fraction gain/(healthy-faulted) when the damage denominator is positive. Report the four values, arithmetic mean, and full range; four endpoint streams on assignment 87004 are not four independent arrays.

Call the fault intervention relevant for this smoke only if mean apparent accuracy falls by at least two percentage points from healthy P0. If it does not, report insufficient recovery headroom and do not interpret a small final change as recovery success.

Call the STAR-inspired local-state-only recovery promising at smoke level only if the mean apparent recovery gain is positive, at least three of four endpoints improve, no endpoint loses more than two percentage points, and mean recovery fraction is at least 0.25 across endpoints with positive fault damage. Otherwise report the endpoint-specific result without claiming repair.

Report persistent-q diagnostic accuracy beside the primary apparent-forward result and compare local hidden/output target-error norms before and after recovery. Apparent improvement with worsening persistent-q accuracy or state error is a robustness warning, not evidence of stable repair.

Separate pulse commands to healthy and immutable cells post hoc, together with per-layer counts, cap hits, saturation, and apparent-versus-persistent movement. Commands sent to a stuck site do not count as repair of that cell; any compensation must be attributed to changed healthy states.

Keep the 1024-example target-calibration cohort, ordered and hash-bound 16-example repair stream, 32-example state-error validation cohort, first-1000-test-example accuracy cohort, one source assignment, four programming streams, FP16 target memory, explicitly enabled model-based preset defects, lack of fresh inference reads/retention/line resistance, and emulated rather than physical local outer-product pulses visible. State that the repair cohort reuses the deterministic 16-example subset used by predeployment continuous HWA, has its own ordered receipt, and is disjoint from the target-calibration cohort. Do not compare the STAR-inspired ablation's superiority with teacher-KL PulseAdam, remapping, spares, multi-mask HWA, or the DRN until separately matched arms are predeclared and run.
